# Smart Tech Zone

> Online store for mobile phone replacement/repair spare parts and accessories in Bangladesh, based in Dhaka. Sells displays, batteries, charging ports, body housings and other repair parts for Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Realme, Nokia, Symphony, itel, Nothing and other phone brands, with nationwide home delivery.

Smart Tech Zone (smarttechzone.com.bd) is a Bangladesh-based e-commerce store specializing in mobile phone replacement/repair spare parts and accessories — not finished phones. Products are also sold on Daraz Bangladesh under the "Smart Tech Zone Dhaka" storefront.

## Store info

- Website: https://smarttechzone.com.bd
- Address: Ataur Rahman Villa, House 49, Road 13, Mohammadpur, Dhaka-1207, Bangladesh
- Phone / WhatsApp: +8801718381066
- Email: mahmud88789@gmail.com
- Currency: BDT (Bangladeshi Taka)
- Delivery: Nationwide home delivery across Bangladesh via courier (Steadfast, Pathao). Cash on delivery and online payment (SSLCommerz) both available.
- Packaging: every order is video-recorded while being packed, and returned items are unboxed on camera, for a transparent and dispute-free process.

## Policies

- [Return & Refund Policy](https://smarttechzone.com.bd/returns-refunds.html): Returns accepted within 14 days of delivery for a wrong item, a defective/damaged item, a quality issue, missing parts, or a simple change of mind — submitted from the customer's My Account page, with photo proof and a choice of refund or replacement.
